question: I'm a CS sophomore with a Business Administration minor. Can 15-122 (Principles of Imperative Computation) count toward both my CS major requirements AND a BA minor requirement at the same time?
expected_answer: Generally, no — CMU's double-counting policy typically does not allow the same course to satisfy requirements in both a major and a minor simultaneously. 15-122 is a CS major requirement and would not be double-counted toward BA minor requirements. P-003 would need to take separate BA courses to satisfy minor requirements. However, CMU's policy on double-counting between a major and a minor should be confirmed, as specific rules may vary.
reasoning_type: Double-counting policy between major and minor requirements
common_mistake: Assuming courses can freely satisfy both major and minor requirements simultaneously; not knowing CMU's anti-double-counting policy
needs_verification: Confirm CMU-Q's official policy on double-counting courses between a major and a minor
Confirm whether 15-122 appears in any BA minor course list (it likely does not, being a CS-specific course)
Confirm whether the BA minor at CMU-Q has any overlap with CS courses that could legally double-count
